verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB ships its own MCP integration, so coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can drive it from natural-language prompts. The documented tools cover listing services, running SQL and reading monitoring, with OAuth 2.1 auth (docs-7). Agent-oriented infrastructure (CHKit typed commands, isolated agent branches, full query logging) supports this workflow, but there is no built-in natural-language interface, and the natural-language layer comes from the external agent. missing for 10: a native natural-language console or assistant, documented MCP coverage of broader operations (cluster creation, scaling, alerts, backups), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
